A rebuilt recording page, a better player, and a guided first lap.

- **Summary and Transcript.** The recording page shows the desktop's brief, highlights and action items, iOS speaker names, and every timestamp jumps to its line.
- **The player scrubs finely** when you drag away from it, remembers your playback speed, and holding either edge of the transcript plays at 2×.
- **Download audio from the Library**, and see at a glance which recordings are on the phone.
- **A dropped connection mid-meeting says it is reconnecting**, and running out of quota says so, instead of looking like the recording stopped.
- **Onboarding v2.** An intro film on sign-in and a guided lap through the sample recording, ending with a done card.
- **What's New after an update**, a fuller Account sheet, and a themed icon.
